title: Conversation replay
description: Replays the user messages of this conversation, in their order, as the turns of a new hidden replay conversation (`origin` `replay`) on the given agent version. Not the history replay of a turn.

targetVersion.title: Target version
targetVersion.description: The agent version to replay on: IRI (`/api/agent_versions/<uuid>`) or full UUID. Any published version, also an older one; an unknown version or a version of a disabled agent answers 422.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Start parameters of the replay conversation; they replace the source's `variables` as a whole (no merge). Omitted: the source's `variables` (none for a conversation without an agent). Validated against the target version's `startSchema`; an undeclared, missing or invalid variable answers 422 at `variables/<name>`, also for source variables the target does not declare.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language tag of the replay conversation, one of the target version's `languages` (422 otherwise). Omitted: the source's language when the target supports it, else the target's `defaultLanguage`.
